thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager — p99 tail latency breach detected for customer 'Sandstone' on cluster: prod-single-tenant-3, route: /v1/chat/stream (streaming stalls). threshold=1200ms p99, current=2300ms. alert_id=INC-2026-0456

olivia (oncall): acked — looking. assigning triage, grabbing logs. 

matt: seeing same in dashboards, p95 ~450ms but p99 blown out. streaming stall traces show a handful of sessions stuck in 'writing' state.

priya: any recent deploys to that tenant?

olivia (oncall): not on our side in last 6h. DevOps shows no infra deploys. customer reported a spike at 12:07UTC via support ticket.

sre-bot: automated correlation: increased prefix fanout and KV cache evictions for tenant_id=sandstone-001 between 12:04-12:20UTC. KV cache miss rate +12%.

matt: grabbing sample of stuck sessions from runtime logs:
```
[2026-03-14T12:05:13Z] session_id=xyz123 state=writing tokens=48 waiting_for_kv:true
[2026-03-14T12:05:14Z] session_id=xyz123 backend=worker-07 status=BLOCKED reason=backpressure
[2026-03-14T12:06:01Z] session_id=abc987 state=writing tokens=22 waiting_for_kv:true
```

priya: that matches a hot-prefix pattern — many similar prefixes from the same customer inflated KV cache churn. likely caused by repeated slightly-different prompts.

olivia (oncall): quick checks: Prometheus query for p99:
```
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{route="/v1/chat/stream", tenant="sandstone-001"}[1m])) by (le))
```
returned 2.3s at peak 12:06UTC.

matt: logs also show worker oom_killer? no OOM but elevated GC pauses on worker-07 and -09. maybe kv cache misses cause heavy recompute/cache-warm which pushes latency.

priya: mitigation options: 1) route Sandstone to fallback non-streaming endpoint (sync) temporarily; 2) increase dedicated pool scale for that tenant; 3) enable aggressive prefix normalization (strip low-value tokens) in router; 4) throttle concurrency per-session for this tenant.

olivia (oncall): immediate action — switch to fallback mode and scale pool. doing routing change now. will post command.

olivia (oncall): /runbook route-manual-override --tenant sandstone-001 --to /v1/chat/sync --duration 15m

incident-bot: runbook executed by olivia (oncall). routing override applied at 12:09:22UTC.

matt: scaling up dedicated pool: kubectl scale statefulset sand-prod-pool-3 --replicas=6 (was 3). scaling request to infra queue.

sre-bot: autoscaler reacted, new pods become ready at 12:13:05UTC.

priya: after routing override and scale, p99 dropped to 500-700ms by 12:16UTC. streaming stalls cleared, but sync route adds ~200-400ms to end-to-end. overall customer impact reduced.

olivia (oncall): customer impact assessment: estimated 18% of active sessions hit the stall window between 12:04-12:09UTC. total affected requests ~2.1k. severity: SLO breach p99>1200ms for ~5 minutes. initiating incident ticket INC-2026-0456 and notifying support.

matt: collecting artifacts for postmortem: runtime traces (xray link), kv cache metrics, sample prompts (redacted), worker GC logs. saving to /incidents/INC-2026-0456/artifacts.

priya: immediate remediation follow-ups:
- implement prefix normalization toggle scoped to tenant to reduce churn
- add adaptive per-tenant concurrency cap to bound tail risk
- improve kv cache admission heuristics for single-tenant pools

olivia (oncall): leaving a note for follow-up owners: matt -> postmortem runbook and perf improvements; priya -> prefix normalization rollout plan; eng-product -> customer communication draft.

matt: FYI I'll do a canary of prefix-normalization in staging and run replay of sampled prompts to validate.

sre-bot: scheduled a follow-up incident review for 2026-03-15T16:00Z.

olivia (oncall): handing off to priya for overnight watch. summary: routing override+scale mitigated, SLO breached for ~5m with ~2.1k impacted requests, suspected cause: hot-prefix induced KV cache churn causing worker GC/backpressure.

priya: ack — will keep watch, will remove routing override after stable for 30m and monitor p99 for 1h.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: incident state: mitigated (routing override + scale). incident_id=INC-2026-0456. timeline recorded.

olivia (oncall): leaving final notes: "If degraded returns after override removal, revert to fallback and escalate to model-onboarding team. Also prep customer-facing RCA draft." :thumbsup:

priya: removing override at 12:47UTC — /runbook route-manual-override --tenant sandstone-001 --remove

incident-bot: override removed. post-override p99 stable at ~600ms. closing on-call watch but keeping incident open for postmortem artifacts.

matt: adding link to ticket with artifacts and sample redacted prompts: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-0456/artifacts

priya: thanks, handing off to next-day SRE rotation. good job team. :coffee:
